exposure: timing of LDA initiation (before or after 16 weeks' gestation)
cohort: Pregnant individuals with chronic hypertension (CHTN) who had a live birth after 23 weeks' gestation between 2013 and 2018.
finding: Low-dose aspirin (LDA) did not reduce superimposed preeclampsia or other adverse maternal outcomes in pregnant individuals with chronic hypertension, but it was associated with a lower composite rate of adverse neonatal outcomes.
